newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank brings deposit rate back down.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank brings deposit rate back down.

text.p: Bangkok Bank Plc has brought its deposit rate back down to 8.25-9.25 percent after raising it to 11.00-11.75 percent on Thursday, a senior bank official said on Wednesday.
The official said the brief rate increase was needed to support the bank's troubled mutual funds.
Bangkok Bank, Thailand's largest commercial bank, on Thursday stunned the market by raising the fixed deposit rate by as much as 250 basis points.
The official said the move was prompted by a run on the bank's four mutual funds. The bank wanted to ensure that fund customers' money remained with the bank.
But it decided to bring the deposit rates back down to avoid the huge interest rate burden.
"We need to keep this group of clients. But the bank did not have any need to raise a big amount of funds by maintaining such high rates as our lending activities have slowed down," he said.
"We feel sorry for any confusion that our policy might cause," he said.
The reversal was effective from Tuesday.
